text: The Patriots made their Gillette Stadium home opener count on Sunday with a dominant 20-3 victory over the Steelers, a win that saw the defense excel in man coverage while TreVeyon Henderson punched in a touchdown run, though the offensive unit hasn't yet recaptured the rhythm from last season's Super Bowl run—a concern that extends to Drake Maye's performance, which film review will surely dissect in detail. The win came at a cost, however, as starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle that will likely sideline him going forward, one of several injuries the Patriots absorbed despite their convincing defensive showing. The victory marked a historic milestone for the franchise, making New England the first of the original AFL teams to reach 600 wins, a testament to sustained excellence that head coach Mike Vrabel will elaborate on in his Monday press conference as the team processes both the triumph and the mounting injury concerns.
